verdict.rationale: Quo's own marketing and pricing pages say a business number can be set up in minutes and that each plan includes a new local or toll-free number. Nothing in the evidence shows searching available inventory by area code, so only the get-a-local-number half of the story is supported. Missing for 10: documented search of available numbers by area code, a description of the selection and purchase flow, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the minutes-level setup.

support.subject: As a founder, I can search available numbers by area code and buy a local number in minutes

citations.quote: Set up a business number in minutes
One new or ported phone number (local or toll-free) per user
Canadian local and toll-free virtual numbers from anywhere
